title: Who receives it
info: An object receives the action. The dog followed him.
Me, you, him, her, it, us, and them can be objects.

questions.q: In Ama called us, the object pronoun is
The teacher helped her. Her means
options: the person who received the help
me, because it is an object
the person doing it in subject place
a whole city name as a proper noun
a boy or man who receives the action

questions.q: Type the object pronoun for a group that includes you.
